policy: Every advertised checkpoint and supported backend needs basic evidence. Missing files, memory limits and failed runs are gaps, never passes. Architecture dispatch alone does not qualify all checkpoints. Numeric thresholds are unchanged. Architectures without a qualified checkpoint are listed under unadvertised_untested and are not release-supported.
